pick.name: RTK (Rust Token Killer)
pick.what: PreToolUse hook that compresses output of 100+ dev commands before Claude reads it
pick.why: Targets the biggest input-token sink (test/build/git output); single binary, winget, telemetry off by default
pick.windows_fit: native: hook installed by `rtk init -g` since v0.37.0, but it only matches the Bash tool; PowerShell-tool commands are not compressed (issue #1319). Re-add 'Bash|PowerShell' matcher manually after each `rtk init`.

alts.name: caveman
alts.why: Self-measured 33% fewer input tokens over 54 runs; only ~3% better than 'be concise' on output

alts.name: Built-in /context + plugin context-cost pruning
alts.what: See per-plugin always-on cost and drop unused ones
alts.why: Removing plugins/MCPs saves more than any compressor

candidates.name: headroom MCP
candidates.verdict: MCP mode only helps when Claude calls it; proxy mode intercepts API traffic - overlaps RTK

decision: Prune plugins first, then RTK compresses command output automatically with no MCP calls. Skip context-compression MCP servers once RTK is in; they overlap and rarely get called.

verify.note: Native Windows: since v0.37.0 `rtk init -g` installs the native `rtk hook claude` PreToolUse hook (confirmed on v0.42.0, issue #2115; README still says CLAUDE.md fallback, which is stale). BUT the matcher is hardcoded to 'Bash': commands from Claude Code's PowerShell tool are NOT rewritten (open issue #1319, last comment 16 Oct 2026), and `rtk init` overwrites a hand-added 'Bash|PowerShell' matcher. If your sessions use the PowerShell tool heavily, savings will be partial. Latest release v1.1.0 (2026-10-25). Licences and telemetry-off confirmed.
